docs.desc: QUARTERLY UNAUDITED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AS OF SEPTEMBER 30, 2026

guidance.heading: Outlook
section: For Q4 2026, we forecast the following results:
Revenue of $984 million to $1,000 million, implying year-over-year organic growth of 5% at the midpoint
Adjusted Operating Income of $470 million to $490 million⁶

desk.headline: Revenue up 125% to $780m on acquisitions, beat; full-year 2026 outlook raised to $3.07–3.09bn
results: Revenue more than doubled to $780m, almost entirely from acquisitions; organic growth was 3%, led by Tractive and WeTransfer and partly offset by lower Remini sales. Airtable added $38m.
Adjusted operating income rose 130% to $424m (a 54% margin); reported operating income rose 34% to $172m after $189m of amortisation of acquired intangibles, including a $65m catch-up charge.
Net income rose 7% to $90m, but diluted EPS slipped to $0.13 from $0.14 as the share count grew 10%; adjusted EPS nearly doubled to $0.42.
Operating cash flow was $261m and net debt fell $187m to $4.00bn, helped by $1.09bn of IPO proceeds, after $1.21bn spent on acquisitions.

Since quarter-end it agreed to buy Mailchimp from Intuit for $3.68bn, closed the $1.36bn Miro deal, raised $330m from Berkshire Hathaway, agreed a $1.30bn share placement and added new notes and term loans.

guidance.summary: Bending Spoons raised its full-year 2026 ranges, citing stronger trading in existing businesses plus Airtable and Miro, and gave a first Q4 forecast. The outlook excludes the pending Mailchimp deal.
